name: Neolithic Site of Çatalhöyük
description: Çatalhöyük is a pair of ancient mounds on the Konya Plain in central Türkiye, southeast of the city of Konya. People lived here for over 2,000 years, beginning around 9,400 years ago. Houses were packed together with no streets, and residents climbed ladders through roof openings to get home. Inside, archaeologists have found painted walls, reliefs and sculptures from one of the world's earliest towns.
